Toss 3 chopped apples with 50g of sugar, 1 tsp of cinnamon, and 0.5 tsp of nutmeg. Arrange in the center of the dough, leaving a 2-inch border. 5. Fold the edges over the apples, brush with egg wash, and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden.

name: Blueberry Oat Muffins
description: Moist and hearty, these blueberry oat muffins are made with whole grains and fresh blueberries, delivering a burst of flavor in every bite. They’re a perfect snack to start your day with a nutritious boost.
recipe_text: 1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a muffin tin with paper liners. 2. In a bowl, mix 200g of rolled oats, 150g of whole wheat flour, 100g of sugar, 2 tsp of baking powder, and a pinch of salt. 3. In another bowl, add 1 egg, 250ml of milk, and 60ml of vegetable oil, whisk until combined. 4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and gently fold in 150g of fresh blueberries. 5. Divide the batter into the muffin tin and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Turmeric Lemon Bars
description: These vibrant turmeric lemon bars are zesty and refreshing, featuring a buttery crust and a tangy lemon filling, enhanced by the warm, earthy notes of turmeric. They offer a unique twist on a classic dessert.
recipe_text: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease an 8x8 inch baking pan. 2. Mix 150g of all-purpose flour, 50g of sugar, and 100g of cold butter until crumbly to form the crust, then press into the pan. Bake for 15 minutes. 3. In a bowl, whisk together 3 eggs, 150g of sugar, 60ml of lemon juice, and 2 tsp of turmeric. 4. Pour the lemon mixture over the pre-baked crust and return to the oven for another 20-25 minutes until set. 5. Let cool before slicing into bars and dusting with powdered sugar.

name: Matcha Coconut Bliss Balls
description: These delightful bites combine the earthy flavor of matcha with the tropical sweetness of coconut. Packed with energy, they offer a refreshing snack that’s both nutritious and satisfying.
recipe_text: 1. In a food processor, blend 1 cup of pitted dates, 1/2 cup of almond flour, and 2 tablespoons of matcha powder until a sticky dough forms. 2. Add 1/2 cup of shredded coconut and mix well. 3. Roll the mixture into small balls, about 1 tablespoon each, and coat them in additional shredded coconut. 4. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to firm up. 5. Enjoy as a refreshing snack or a quick breakfast pick-me-up.

name: Sweet Potato Brownies
description: These brownies are a comforting blend of sweet potatoes and rich cocoa, creating a fudgy dessert that's both wholesome and indulgent. With a hint of vanilla, they are perfect for chocolate lovers seeking a healthier option.
recipe_text: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper. 2. In a bowl, mash 1 cup of cooked sweet potato and mix with 1/2 cup of almond butter, 1/4 cup of maple syrup, and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract. 3. In another bowl, combine 1/2 cup of cocoa powder, 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda, and a pinch of salt. 4. Gradually mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until well combined. 5. Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Chia Seed Pudding Parfait
description: This chia seed pudding is layered with luscious almond yogurt and topped with fresh berries for a refreshing and nutritious snack. Each spoonful offers a creamy texture with a burst of fruity flavor.
recipe_text: 1. In a bowl, combine 1/3 cup of chia seeds with 1 cup of almond milk, 1 tablespoon of maple syrup, and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract. Stir well and let it sit for 10 minutes, then stir again. 2. Once thickened, layer the pudding in a glass with 1/2 cup of almond yogurt and 1/2 cup of mixed berries. 3. Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used. 4. Let it chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before enjoying. 5. Serve cold, garnished with extra berries if desired.

name: Cardamom-Pistachio Halwa
description: This traditional Indian dessert features a fragrant blend of cardamom and crunchy pistachios in a sweet, grainy base. It's a warm and rich delight that melts in your mouth, making it perfect for any occasion.
recipe_text: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a saucepan over medium heat. 2. Add 1 cup of semolina and roast for 5-7 minutes until golden brown. 3. Stir in 1 cup of milk, 1/2 cup of sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon of cardamom powder. Cook until the mixture thickens, about 5 minutes. 4. Fold in 1/2 cup of chopped pistachios and mix well. 5. Pour into a greased plate, let it cool for a few minutes, and cut into squares to serve.

name: Lavender Honey Shortbread Cookies
description: These delicate shortbread cookies are infused with fragrant lavender and sweetened with honey, offering a unique twist on a classic treat. Perfectly buttery, they are a beautiful snack for tea time or any occasion.
recipe_text: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. In a bowl, cream together 1 cup of unsalted butter and 1/2 cup of honey until smooth. 3. Mix in 2 cups of all-purpose flour, 1/4 teaspoon of salt, and 1 tablespoon of dried lavender until well combined. 4. Roll the dough into small balls and flatten them slightly before placing them on the prepared baking sheet. 5. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden, then let cool.
